artBrief: **Cute chibi.** A delighted little creature proudly holds a single star-shaped card close to its chest. A tiny celebratory sparkle, no brain or intelligence ranking imagery.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Cute chibi. A delighted little creature proudly holds a single star-shaped card close to its chest. A tiny celebratory sparkle, no brain or intelligence ranking imagery. The delighted creature is the app's white fox, with pointed ears, tapered muzzle and fluffy tail. Make the large gold star-shaped card and pleased expression the focus.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
